Team managers to ensure the drivers ID are correct.

The driver must leave the car as soon as possible.
The driver must help with the recovery operations.
Car must be left in neutral with steering wheel in position.

If the “medical light” is activated, the driver must be examined by the medical services without delay.

Zig-Zag / weave your car oU track before rejoining to drop the gravel / dirt oU the line.
If the car is stopped for technical reasons, the scrutineers will release the car when they are satisfied with the repairs.
In Hypercar category, it is up to each competitor to ensure that the car is electrically safe at all times. The car must
either have the ERS operating light illuminated (green light) or have a distinctive sign (green hat) visible to all. This sign

FULL COURSE YELLOW – 24 Hours of Le Mans Supplementary Regulations Article 14.5
Yellow flags will be waved around the track and FCY board will be presented in the marshal posts.

if the pit entry closed light is turned on.

2024 – Drivers briefing notes – 24 Hours of Le Mans
Maximum speed in pit lane: 60 km/h.
Pit lane speed must be respected from pit in loop (60 km/h marker board) to pit out loop (60 km/h marker board).
Red / green at pit exit must be respected at all times.
If the red lights are on at pit exit: any car waiting at pit exit must stop before the RFID or 3 meters before the pit
Cars can be stopped by scrutineering at any time; drivers must respect the signal of the scrutineers.
Any car driving unnecessarily slow in the fast lane will be reported to the Stewards.
Judges of fact will be appointed to control sporting details from the Regulations.
On-board marshalling system will be used.
At all times on track, whether it is a flag or a light panel, the more restrictive will prevail, irrelevant of its source.

must leave the racing line immediately.
